summary: NETSTREIT Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a new at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program of up to $400 million in common stock. The issuer entered into a sales agreement with 18 agents, including forward sale provisions with designated forward purchasers. No specific price per share, premium, or expected close date is stated, as shares will be sold from time to time at prevailing market prices. The board has not expressed a recommendation in this filing; mechanics involve both direct sales and forward sales to manage dilution. This capital-raising event is structured as a continuous equity offering. Watch for the pace of issuance and potential share price pressure as shares are sold into the market.
